notes: All 55 ABI functions and the fallback reviewed; no semantic error found. initialize, move / attack / defend, step, addLocalData, challengeRootL2Block, resolveClaim, resolve, closeGame, claimCredit by structure (status and enum checks, clone-arg reads, claim hashing, clock arithmetic with its checked adds, bond accounting and WETH unlock/withdraw, anchor registry calls, the RLP header decoding and output-root proof check). Source loops (5): resolveClaim's subgame loop, _findTraceAncestor (inlined 4 times), _findStartingAndDisputedOutputs' depth loop, RLPReader.readList's item loop and RLPReader._copy (a word copy left as a while, see the finding): all whiles. Implicit: readList's RLPItem[] allocation (rotated count-down loop, P3). The lnWad / expWad code of getRequiredBond is unreachable because of the immutables and is not printed.
summary: Faithful; the dispute-game logic reads well except for the raw clone-argument expressions and the flat 5-slot ClaimData indexing, and several functions are degenerate only because the immutables (MAX_GAME_DEPTH, MAX_CLOCK_DURATION...) read as 0.
